#
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**¶2**


Divine
 Love is the
 Infinite
 Being
 itself, dwelling
 in the
 in
most good
 of
 its
 own celest
ial life
. The whole
 of the Divine
 nature
 stands
 revealed within
 that
 good
, for there
 is nothing
 in
 the Divine which
 is not Love
 and
 which does
 not proceed
 from Love. These
 two —
 the
 Divine Being
 and its own
 Love — are not
 two but one life
.
 Because
 the Divine gives
 itself wholly
 into
 all the
 forms
 through
 which it proceeds, as
 it lives
 within
 its own
 infinite states of wisdom
 and good
, therefore
 the
 anc
ients called the
 Divine itself
,
 the sovereign
 of all
 that
 exists
, by
 the name *
Love
.
* For it
 is
 through
 Love alone
 that the Divine communic
ates its
 own power
 and
 life to every
 proce
eding state
 and
 to
 every faculty
 that
 receives
 it.


---


**¶4**

Self
-love is the first
 spiritual
 death that
 arose
 from
 the prop
rium.
 It brought
 into full
 manifestation the entire realm of falsity
 and evil. It
 is
 called
 *hatred
,
* because self
-love dev
ours even
 the
 ev
ils it
 has itself en
gendered —
 it consumes its
 own offspring.
 More
 than this:
 it ass
aul
ted what
 was utt
erly foreign to its
 own nature
 —
 the goods and truths of heaven —
 and prof
aned them. Therefore
 it is named
 *the
 hated,* for it works
 destruction both
 in what belongs to the
 prop
rium and
 in what does not belong to it
 at
 all.

---

**¶
5**

And
 so it
 continues
 perpet
ually:
 self
-love wounds
 and
 destroys the voluntary
 life in
 every
 soul
. It ext
inguishes spiritual
 life through
 falsities
 of
 every kind and
 genus
 —
 the
 inn
umerable forms
 of spiritual
 death visible
 in every
 state
 and
 in every type
 of
 human
 experience
. Even
 the good
 of innocence suffering
 in states of temptation —
 the living
 truth
 itself dispers
ed
 throughout
 creation
 — even
 this,
 self-love ass
aults and seeks to extinguish,
 as it has
 done from the first
 state
 of the Fall. Therefore the
 ancients named
 it *hatred
 born
 of hatred
,
 en
vy born of envy, the
 inf
ernal born
 of the infernal,
 evil
 proce
eding from evil*
 — for
 every evil
 is
 self
-propagating and
 derives always
 from a prior evil of its
 own genus.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Love is the Father of Greatness, who dwells in his glorious land. The entirety of the divine has been revealed [there]in! These two are a single living body, the Father and his love; because he has given himself for every thing, as he exists in his aeons. Indeed, due to this, they called the Father, the Lord of the totality, 'love'. For he gave the victory to his aeons and his limbs.

Hate is the first death that welled up. It revealed the land of darkness. This one called 'hate', because it has ruined all its perdition's offspring; it sinned even against a power foreign to it, and ruined it. Due to this they shall call it 'hated'; for it has caused destruction, both wounding in flesh, and what is not its own.

Today again it causes wounding and destruction in all flesh. It kills them all with diverse deaths; these that are displayed today in every thing, in every type. Even the Cross of Light, the living soul, likewise too it ruins and kills them; as it did at the start. Indeed, due to this have they called it 'hated', this one from the hated; the envy from the envy; the devil from the devil; the bad that came about from the bad.
